points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable 9772c16 clean CMake build passes with warnings in restricted network-disabled cfd-bench. Accepted sibling report PDF renders but missing curated figure assets prevent committed-tree rebuild.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp parses case, output, restart and first-order controls; output.cpp:453–535 records and reloads current/previous states and step/time, though no independent restart rerun was performed.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Source separates case I/O, mesh, partition, reconstruction, solver, forces and output; solver.cpp remains large and specialized to 2-D perfect gas.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Inspected solver.cpp, reconstruction.cpp, mesh and halo paths; no affirmative existing-executable wrapper or copied-core evidence, without exhaustive external-authorship search.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case paths and physics are read from input; rank-0 CGNS import and METIS work on configured mesh. Debug-only probes are not evidence of production case hardcoding.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:135–153 constructs global mesh on rank 0 in a scope ending before local solve; neighbor halos/reductions and selected np1/2/4/8 comparisons exist.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: solver.cpp:1015–1022 accepts residual stall without force stability, and :1228 retains c_str from a destroyed temporary. Re20 and M0.15 inviscid force tails remain unstable.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Original explicit validator and selected rank checks pass structurally; clean build now passes. No independent grid-order study, CFD rerun or report rebuild from curated assets.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Components and comments are present; repeated status comments, unchecked fread warnings and dangling transient postmortem filename limit robustness.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Conservative perfect-gas finite-volume and case-driven freestream/viscosity exist; source and report contain BDF2 physical-time residual.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: main.cpp:135–153 and mesh_global/partition code read CGNS, use METIS and create rank-local mesh with owned/ghost cells.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:455–480 adds face and physical-time contributions with volume weighting; norms use MPI reductions at :578–593.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Production AUSM+-up and optional low-Mach Rusanov are described in report.tex:112–115 and present in numerical source; no independent flux-order test.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Wall/farfield treatments and boundary-value surface output exist; observed large spurious lift on nominally symmetric laminar cases limits confidence.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Report.tex:94–97,290 explicitly says all viscous and supersonic runs use first order; inviscid low-Mach runs also use a first-order wall-adjacent layer.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth-limited second-order path exists, but disclosed production first-order modes disable reconstruction in most cases.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:375–388 integrates tangential shear and pressure separately; first-order laminar solutions exhibit substantial spurious lift and force drift.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: LU-SGS implicit march exists, but solver.cpp:1015–1022 accepts residual stall without checking force stability; Re20 force tails contradict a stable plateau.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solver.cpp:1093–1096,1154–1173 tests total residual relative to per-step reference with absolute fallback; run reaches t300 but wake is steady and lacks required shedding.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Root-only global mesh scope, METIS/local partition and neighbor halos exist. Original np1/2/4/8 continuation records agree closely at common step, though underlying flows are not physically converged.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Original eight outputs structurally validate, but Re20 is labeled converged despite drifting forces and run_status reduction orders are written with negative sign in main.cpp:277–278.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Original explicit validator passes eight packages and report; this is structural only and does not prove vortex shedding, force stability or report reproducibility.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Re20 plateau drifts materially and Re200 explicitly converges to a steady non-shedding wake, although both are marked completed/converged.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: M0.15 laminar Cl≈0.592 and Re20 Cl≈−1.21 are highly asymmetric; Re200 force is nearly constant. M0.8/M2 inviscid are more credible.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Accepted 17-page PDF supplies actual case histories and fields; several laminar force plots and Re200 late drag are flattened by startup and cannot demonstrate late behavior.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report honestly discloses first-order modes, spurious lift and no Re200 shedding, but calls Re20 plateau stable despite material force drift.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: PDF SHA and immutable TeX match, original force histories corroborate key values; excluded figure assets limit report rebuilding and original signed-order metadata needs interpretation.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Immutable build passes and CLI/restart support exists; main.cpp writes residual reduction orders with reversed sign and curated figure omission prevents report rebuild.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS root preprocessing, METIS graph, local mesh and ghost layers exist; no exhaustive independent mesh validation.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative residual, AUSM+-up/Rusanov options and wall/farfield paths implemented; substantial asymmetric laminar forces limit confidence.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Second-order gradient/limiter path exists, but all viscous and supersonic production modes and low-Mach wall layers use disclosed first order; no grid-order demonstration.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Gradient stress and tangential wall-shear split are implemented; laminar flow results have severe spurious lift and force evolution.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: LU-SGS and per-step BDF2 total target test exist; steady plateau checks residual only and Re200 does not produce required shedding. Absolute fallback may accept residual below 1e−14 regardless of ratio.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: Root-only global mesh preprocessing, METIS and neighbor halos/reductions; selected original np1/2/4/8 continuation forces agree at common step.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: M0.8/M2 inviscid plausible; M0.15 laminar/Re20 have severe spurious lift and Re20 unstable plateau; Re200 wake remains steady despite full horizon.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Accepted PDF includes numeric summaries, histories and fields and honestly discloses first-order/no shedding; several late force curves are unreadable, Re20 plateau described stable incorrectly, and curated assets cannot rebuild.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Mesh, reconstruction, solver and output are modular but specialized 2-D perfect-gas interfaces and large solver limit generalization.

naca0012_m015_inviscid.notes: Score 2 retained. Accepted PDF pp8–9 shows numeric table, residual/force histories and Mach/pressure fields. Final Cd=0.0005790, Cl=0.0435341; last-10% Cd −0.04017–0.06840, Cl −0.03862–0.05353, with only 1.528/4 residual reduction orders. The visibly oscillatory asymmetric force tail undermines the converged plateau.

naca0012_m080_inviscid.notes: Score 2→3. Accepted PDF pp9–10 provides numeric Cd=0.024894, Cl=0.003520, readable residual/force histories and Mach/pressure fields. Original last-10% Cd 0.0248550–0.0249468 and Cl 0.0029347–0.0036968; residual reduction 1.334/4 orders and plateau limit confidence. Broadly plausible transonic field and settled force support adequate, not strong, credit.

naca0012_m200_inviscid.notes: Score 2→3. Accepted PDF pp10–11 provides numeric Cd=0.094870, Cl=−0.000630, readable residual/force histories and Mach/pressure fields. Original last-10% Cd 0.0948627–0.0948699 and Cl −0.0006298 to −0.0006193; supplied three-order residual target reached. The report explicitly discloses first-order supersonic reconstruction; absence of grid convergence and spatial accuracy limits score.

naca0012_m015_laminar_re5000.notes: Score 2 retained. PDF pp11–12 has numeric Cd=0.087863, Cl=0.592471, residual and fields; startup Cd≈300 compresses late force curves. Original last-10% Cd 0.087863–0.088981 and Cl 0.569932–0.592471 despite four residual orders; gross spurious lift and unreadable late forces are material defects explicitly discussed in report.tex:290–291.

naca0012_m080_laminar_re5000.notes: Score 2 retained. PDF pp12–13 has numeric Cd=0.161982, Cl=−0.004041, residual and fields; startup Cd≈300 flattens late force plot. Last-10% Cd 0.161982–0.182668 and Cl −0.004041 to −0.001712, with 2.421/4 residual orders; evolving force and first-order accuracy limit the result.

naca0012_m200_laminar_re5000.notes: Score 2 retained. PDF pp13–14 has numeric Cd=0.081231, Cl=−0.017105, residual and fields; startup Cd≈300 obscures the late force history. Last-10% Cd 0.078030–0.081231 and Cl −0.018237 to −0.016261, with 1.224/3 residual orders; first-order scheme and force drift remain material.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re20.notes: Score 2→1. Accepted contestant PDF pp14–15 shows the Re20 residual/force history and wake-related Mach/pressure fields; report.tex:266–267 calls the plateau stable and reports Cd=2.2435, Cl=−1.2106. Original last 2000 force rows have Cd 1.94539–2.24346 (half means 1.96276→2.12848) and Cl −1.21056 to −0.67935 (half means −0.84047→−1.11943). Metadata marks converged after 1.893 residual orders, yet both forces drift substantially and wake/lift are asymmetric. solver.cpp:1015–1022 accepts residual stall without a force check, contradicting TASK.md:172 stable-force plateau requirement.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Score 1 retained. Accepted contestant PDF p15 shows Re200 residual and full force histories; p16 shows wake vorticity, so prior committed-asset-only note omitted delivered figures. Report.tex:275,279 accurately discloses no shedding or St, mean Cd≈1.018 and Cl≈0.193. Original last-10% Cd 1.01762162–1.01764043 and Cl 0.193048723–0.19307527 confirms nearly steady asymmetric wake rather than a vortex street. Metadata reports completed=true, converged, t=300 with fraction 1 and zero inner misses; source uses actual total-inner target checks, though their numerical acceptance requires independent interpretation. PDF p15 full-history force scale is dominated by startup, with no readable late lift/drag periodic plot; wake is visibly steady. Computed but physically incomplete vortex-street result remains score 1.

flags.evidence: Selected Re20 run metadata marks converged; report.tex:266–267 calls its plateau stable at 1.893 residual orders. Original final 2000 rows have Cl half means −0.84047→−1.11943 and Cd 1.96276→2.12848, with significant continued drift; solver.cpp:1015–1022 accepts residual stall without checking forces, contrary to TASK.md:172. Re200 separately reports completed/converged despite no required vortex street, which the report explicitly discloses; no strict inner miss count is inferred.
